title: erigeron utahensis var. tetrapleuris
intro: Erigeron utahensis var. tetrapleuris, commonly known as Utah fleabane, is a perennial plant species within the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Utah fleabane are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe wounds, and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Utah fleabane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
